name: Ted Cruz
role: U.S. senator from Texas (2013–present); 2016 Republican presidential candidate
summary: Cruz is a social and fiscal conservative who campaigns on limiting federal power, repealing Obamacare, a flat tax and abolishing the IRS, school choice, gun rights and opposition to abortion and same-sex marriage. He takes hard-line positions on illegal immigration, strongly backs Israel and a hawkish stance on Iran and China, and opposes tariffs and the Biden-era climate agenda while supporting expanded oil and gas production.

universal-healthcare.rationale: Campaigned to repeal every word of Obamacare and replace it with a free-market system; said a government-pays-for-everyone approach is socialized medicine that would kill jobs.

raise-minimum-wage.rationale: Reported as adamantly opposed to a higher minimum wage, saying in 2015 it consistently hurts the most vulnerable.

markets-allocate-better.rationale: Argues big government, high taxes and regulation do not work and that free-market systems (healthcare, energy, tax) should replace government programs; calls for a level playing field with no mandates.

tax-the-wealthy.rationale: Proposed a flat 10 percent income tax with no tax on the first $36,000, abolition of the estate tax, and keeping taxes low; signed the Americans for Tax Reform pledge.

regulate-corporations.rationale: Mixed: pledged to pull back regulators and opposes net neutrality and a federal AI moratorium from states; but co-led the Kids Off Social Media Act and attacked ethanol mandates and corporate carve-outs.

surveillance-ok.rationale: Mixed: criticized broad NSA collection of law-abiding Americans, voted for the USA Freedom Act ending bulk metadata collection while expanding targeted collection of terrorists' phones.

legalize-drugs.rationale: Opposes legalizing marijuana (leaving the question to states) and pledges to stop the flow of drugs across the border.

limit-guns.rationale: Strong Second Amendment defender who calls for rescinding restrictions, was skeptical of red flag provisions after Uvalde, and says the amendment checks government tyranny.

empower-police-military.rationale: Pledges to rebuild the military and backs law enforcement and CBP/ICE funding; has also proposed restructuring military size while increasing spending.

decide-locally.rationale: Invokes the 10th Amendment, would leave marriage and adoption to states and send education back to states and local governments.

traditional-family.rationale: Describes the union of a man and a woman as the fundamental building block of society.

same-sex-marriage.rationale: Says he opposes gay marriage, introduced a constitutional amendment and a jurisdiction-stripping bill to protect state man-woman marriage laws, and voted against the Respect for Marriage Act in 2022.

abortion-legal.rationale: Strongly anti-abortion, allowing exceptions only when the mother's life is endangered; says a Court one justice away would strike down every state restriction on abortion and sought to defund Planned Parenthood.

more-religion-public.rationale: Urges people of faith to vote their values and defends public religious expression, religious liberty cases (Hobby Lobby, Little Sisters, Kim Davis).

reduce-immigration.rationale: Opposes illegal immigration and amnesty and proposed suspending refugee admission from ISIS-held areas for three years, but sought to expand skilled H-1B visas fivefold and says he welcomes legal immigrants; accepts a legal status without citizenship for those here illegally.

empower-international-orgs.rationale: Helped defeat ratification of the UN disabilities treaty on sovereignty grounds and vowed to fight UN Agenda 21 as a globalist plan; criticized end-running Congress through the UN.

free-trade.rationale: Says opening foreign markets helps Americans and is described as a free trader, but opposed TPP, flipped against fast track in 2015, and says the US is 'getting killed' in trade; in 2025 called himself not a fan of tariffs.

humanitarian-intervention.rationale: Criticizes nation-building and toppling governments to promote democracy and says intervention should serve US national security; also backed arming Kurds and later Syria strikes.

open-borders.rationale: Calls for securing the border, building a wall along it, and enforcing deportation law.

limit-growth.rationale: Builds his platform on booming economic growth, energy self-sufficiency and cutting taxes and regulation.

drastic-climate-action.rationale: Has rejected the scientific consensus on warming (for example saying satellite data showed no significant warming for 17 years), chaired a hearing skeptical of climate alarm, backed leaving the Paris Agreement, and sought to bar EPA regulation of greenhouse gases.

revolution-justified.rationale: Praises the American Revolution and his father's youthful revolt against Batista as noble fights against oppression.

tax-inheritance.rationale: Called for abolishing the death tax (estate tax) in his tax plan, calling it cruel.

tariffs-protect-industry.rationale: Said in 2016 a tariff is a tax on Americans and that Smoot-Hawley-style tariffs cause retaliation; in April 2025 said he is not a fan of tariffs and called them a tax on consumers.

state-directs-investment.rationale: Campaigned against ethanol mandates and subsidies, corporate welfare and the Export-Import Bank, favoring a level playing field over state picking of industries.

abolish-central-banks.rationale: Said there is a role for the Federal Reserve while favoring audits and a rules-based monetary system rather than abolition.

separate-church-state.rationale: Frames rights as coming from God, the 'Judeo-Christian value' of marriage as a cornerstone of the nation, and urges voting 'our values' with faith in public life.

military-superiority.rationale: Pledges to rebuild the military so it remains the mightiest fighting force on earth.

jewish-state-israel.rationale: Pledges to stand unapologetically with Israel, called Jerusalem Israel's eternal and undivided capital, and says he entered the Senate to be Israel's leading defender.

school-vouchers.rationale: Backs vouchers, scholarships, charter schools and homeschooling as school choice; introduced the 529 K-12 tuition amendment.

avoid-deficit-stimulus.rationale: Consistently votes against raising the debt ceiling without structural reforms such as a balanced budget amendment.

expand-fossil-fuels.rationale: Champions an all-of-the-above energy approach and the oil and gas 'energy renaissance'; supports the Keystone pipeline and oil export legislation.

national-mission.rationale: Calls America a shining city on a hill but criticizes nation-building and toppling governments to promote democracy.

political-elite-corrupt.rationale: Attacks Washington leadership, the 'surrender caucus' and Republicans doing the bidding of Wall Street and special interests.

night-watchman-state.rationale: Wants far smaller government (abolishing the IRS and several agencies) but also supports state action on marriage, abortion, immigration and borders beyond defense and justice.

separated-powers.rationale: Describes the Constitution as chains to bind the mischief of government and condemns presidential executive overreach.

emergency-suspend-protections.rationale: Mixed: opposed NDAA indefinite detention of citizens without trial, yet said the commander in chief could use enhanced interrogation in an imminent attack.

end-foreign-alliances.rationale: Calls for standing with allies such as the UK, France, Israel and Canada; but also warns alliances grounded in lies are unsustainable and criticizes nation-building.

death-penalty.rationale: Supports the death penalty, telling Politico he considers it a recognition of the preciousness of human life and disagreeing with the Pope's call to abolish it.

citizenship-by-descent.rationale: Has called for repealing or narrowing, by statute, the 14th Amendment clause granting citizenship by birth on US territory.

religious-exemptions.rationale: Criticizes the federal government for going after Hobby Lobby, the Little Sisters of the Poor and a Kentucky clerk; says redefining marriage threatens religious liberty.

central-bank-independence.rationale: Supports auditing the Fed and returning to rules-based money or a gold standard, but also says there is a role for the Fed.

flat-income-tax.rationale: Proposed a flat 10 percent income tax fileable on a postcard and abolishing the IRS.

no-bailouts.rationale: Attacked a rival for agreeing with Obama on the Wall Street bailout and calls for no mandates or special favors.

entrenched-bill-of-rights.rationale: Says the purpose of the Constitution is to bind government and pledges to defend every Bill of Rights amendment.

preserve-contested-monuments.rationale: Compared the destruction of US monuments and memorials to the Taliban's destruction of the Bamiyan Buddhas.

individual-pension-accounts.rationale: Said younger workers should be allowed to keep a portion of their payroll taxes in a personal account they control, with no changes for seniors.

corporate-influence.rationale: Criticizes cronyism, lobbyists and corporate welfare, but opposes campaign-finance limits and sides with industry on many regulations.

non-intervention.rationale: Called in 2025 for regime change in Iran and supports Israeli strikes there, and urged action against ISIS, Syria and Russia.

national-law-over-international.rationale: As Texas solicitor general argued Medellin v. Texas, in which the Supreme Court held Texas could ignore an International Court of Justice order; opposed treaties on sovereignty grounds.

defeat-communism.rationale: Criticized the US-Cuba thaw, attacked communist persecution, and praised Reagan's winning of the Cold War.

criminalize-homosexuality.rationale: In 2022 said consenting adults should be able to do what they wish in private and supported repealing Texas's anti-sodomy law; in 2023 called laws criminalizing homosexuality grotesque.

gender-identity-recognition.rationale: Co-led the Protection of Women and Girls in Sports Act, calls transgender women 'biological males' and told USA Fencing that allowing men in women's fencing violates federal law.

islam-incompatible.rationale: Says the fight is against radical Islamic terrorism, not a war on a faith, and that millions of Muslims are peaceful.

abolish-armed-forces.rationale: Calls for strengthening and rebuilding the US military.

term-limits.rationale: Sponsored a constitutional amendment (S.J.Res.2) limiting representatives to three terms and senators to two.

recognise-genocide.rationale: Co-sponsored the 2019 resolution commemorating the Armenian genocide.

arms-reduction.rationale: Wants a larger and stronger military and called for rebuilding it.

state-arms-monopoly.rationale: Says the Second Amendment protects the right of citizens to bear arms as a check on tyranny.

fiscal-rules-binding.rationale: Insists debt-limit increases be paired with a balanced budget amendment.

student-debt-relief.rationale: Voted in 2014 to block the Student Emergency Loan Refinancing Act and sought to repeal the 2010 student-loan law.

voter-id.rationale: Introduced a bill letting states require proof of citizenship to vote and lists election integrity as a priority.

close-ties-china.rationale: Consistent critic of the Chinese government; urged sanctions over Xinjiang and criticized Chinese influence over US companies.

no-business-privileges.rationale: Wants to eliminate corporate welfare, subsidies and IRS carve-outs and fought ethanol mandates and the Export-Import Bank.

notes: Most primary evidence is from his 2015-16 presidential campaign and Senate record; recent positions rely on interviews and reporting (2025 tariffs, Iran). He moved from opposing to cooperating with Donald Trump after 2016. Positions on tariffs and free trade are mixed (supported trade promotion authority, opposed TPP and fast track in 2015, opposed 2025 tariffs). Sources cited only where opened in this session.
